stem: Students are modeling mRNA during the process of protein synthesis. Which answer choice correctly describes the model of the mRNA strand being transcribed?

options.label: F
options.text: The mRNA strand is complementary to the DNA template strand; however, uracil instead of adenine is paired with thymine.

options.label: G
options.text: The mRNA strand is complementary to the DNA template strand; however, uracil instead of thymine is paired with adenine.

options.label: H
options.text: The mRNA strand is an exact copy of the DNA template strand; however, uracil instead of adenine is paired with thymine.

options.label: J
options.text: The mRNA strand is an exact copy of the DNA template strand; however, uracil instead of thymine is paired with adenine.
